findings.source_quote: Still others think the bride will be raptured before this, hence nothing for us to be concerned with.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the awkward phrase “die bruidegom se bruid sal voor dit verhef word” with a natural rendering of the English meaning, e.g. “die bruid sal hieraan vooraf verhef word” so it reads that some believe ‘the bride’ (the church) will be raptured before these events.
findings.translation_quote: Weer ander dink die bruidegom se bruid sal voor dit verhef word, dus is daar niks om oor bekommerd te wees nie.

findings.source_quote: One of the things you will notice in this writing is that I don’t call the Covid shot a ‘vaccine’.
findings.suggested_fix: Correct the punctuation/extra quote around the Afrikaans word for vaccine. For example: change “die Covid-inspuiting nie ’n '-entstof' noem nie.” to “die Covid-inspuiting nie ’n entstof noem nie.” (preserve surrounding HTML tags).
findings.translation_quote: Een van die dinge wat u in hierdie stuk sal opmerk, is dat ek die Covid-inspuiting nie ’n '-entstof' noem nie.
